comment.body:
Thanks for reporting that the Alt+J to Alt+Left mapping sometimes fails after hibernation while other mappings work. The report is from PowerToys 0.70.0 and has no current retest. Could you please provide:
1. Whether the unchanged all-apps mapping fails on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer, and whether failure is immediate after resume or later.
2. The exact suspend/resume and key sequence if it still fails, including whether other mappings continue working.
3. A fresh diagnostic archive by commenting `/bugreport` immediately after the failure.
This will distinguish a current resume-state issue from a mapping-specific problem.
